# DeFi Yield Switch

> Free no-wallet browser-local calculator for DeFi vault yield switching fee break-even.

Official URL: https://livastic-vm2-primary-20260911.github.io/defi-yield-switch/
Korean: https://livastic-vm2-primary-20260911.github.io/defi-yield-switch/ko/
Open source: https://github.com/livastic-vm2-primary-20260911/defi-yield-switch
Price to use calculator: Free (0 USD, 0 USDC). No signup, wallet connection, API key, tracking, uploaded data or deposit.
Calculator source: assets/calculator.mjs; deterministic tests: tests/calculator.test.mjs.

IMPORTANT: User-entered, constant simple annualized APYs are NOT live rates, forecasts, financial or tax advice. Fees, bridge issues, vault exit locks, reward token risk and protocol safety require verification outside this model. There is no onchain connection or real crypto action.
Optional one-owner 15 USDC scoped report: inquiry only; requires agreed scope before any payment. Optional public wallet tip is NOT an API sale. No independently verified sales of this report yet.
